Yeah it's been over the course of several years - I started reviewing on YouTube before Steam Curation was a thing. It's a nice feature for my subscribers to instantly see if I have a text or video opinion of any particular title.
Even over ten years that's more than ten reviews a week. How do you find the time? For a review you not only need the time to record and edit the video, you need to test the game first.

Yeah it does take quite a bit of time, although some indie games are only a couple hours long. (so it might take 4-5 hours to produce an indie game review, versus 12-16 for a AAA game)

And I usually just record while I'm playing and then splice together interesting footage with a voiceover after I have a solid opinion of it. Takes more hard drive space, but I find it's a lot easier if I can just record everything rather than trying to capture specific moments - then sort it out later.
